title: Pokémon Pokopia [Switch 2]
description: Pokémon Pokopia is a Nintendo Switch 2 life-simulation adventure developed by KOEI TECMO GAMES. Players shape a growing settlement and interact with Pokémon through gathering, crafting, exploration, and habitat building, with multiplayer options supported. The seller lists four account variants, so the DLC types use the official Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass; Part 1 is titled Bubbly Basin.

gameplayPillars.description: Collect resources and turn them into tools, furniture, and settlement improvements.

gameplayPillars.description: Observe, meet, and cooperate with Pokémon as the environment develops.

worldSummary: Pokopia centers on a developing environment where Pokémon and the player transform empty spaces into living habitats and shared communities.

storyChapters.title: A Withered World
storyChapters.body: A peculiar Ditto awakens in a desolate land where people are gone and Professor Tangrowth is one of the few remaining residents.

storyChapters.title: Build a Pokémon Paradise
storyChapters.body: Ditto learns Pokémon moves, gathers resources, grows crops, crafts furniture, and rebuilds habitats that attract more Pokémon.

storyChapters.title: A Community Takes Shape
storyChapters.body: As the environment improves, new Pokémon and visitors arrive, expanding the settlement and opening additional areas, activities, and multiplayer possibilities.
